finding: The generator uses a discrete attacker campaign with hidden resistance, delay, event, and response draws. The DMP predictor uses a separate observation-side transmission operator and calibrated phase models. Review found no identical fitted latent equation reused across generator and predictor.
limitations: The predictor intentionally consumes noisy observations derived from some generator constructs. This is a synthetic sensor model, not statistical independence.
Structural separation does not establish external validity or implementation security.
The audit is hash-bound with the reviewed sources at protocol freeze. Any source change invalidates the confirmatory manifest.
